title: Law to require delivery apps to flag unsafe e-bike riding
summary: This bill would require third-party food delivery services to track delivery workers using bicycles with electric assist or limited-use motorcycles and alert them in real time if they speed, go the wrong way on a one-way street, or ride on sidewalks. Workers who receive three such alerts within seven days could not be assigned deliveries until completing a road safety course. Delivery services would also have to file quarterly reports on these notifications to the city.
